_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); chemical and refining signals

pit_profile.why: Risk factor (FY2012 10-K): Our businesses’ results are impacted by seasonal effects and are highly cyclical.; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud or offshore delivery), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Risk factor (FY2012 10-K): Our businesses’ results are impacted by seasonal effects and are highly cyclical.; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud or offshore delivery), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 6.75x; +118% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.28; conservative 2yr -32%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY11-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -10.2%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 2.4-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.8%/yr (FY11-FY12 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +14.8%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY11-FY12: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2013-06-07) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 6.75x (43.0% downside to Bear $37 / +6.4% upside to Bull $69) | Adj composite 1.65 vs market 3.93: gap -2.28 [OVERVALUED] | +118% above the EPP floor $30 (6x FY13E $4.96) | Conservative 2-yr case: -32.5% total (-16.2%/yr) | At 13.1x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $86 sits above the BULL case; O&P–Americas +58.2% and Intermediates & Derivatives -12.7% operating income in Q1 2013, forward revenues -9.1% (no FY13 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2013 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date; none has dated evidence.
